title: Explicit removal is uniform on its literal activated domain
statement: For fixed integer reference N, rational 0<m0<=1e-6,h=400/m0^2,N>=32h, EVERY actual state with .75N<S(0)<=1.25N and A+min(C,D)>=m0N has P[S(h)>13N/16] bounded by 32N^2 h exp(-m0N/1000)+exp[-200N^2/(32h+20/3)]+exp(-N/2)+exp(-N/96). Full falling-factorial generator, A0/1, curvature/storage/occupation/adverse stops and ONE original full-horizon immigration counter are paid. Endpoint is reference-based, not a fractional decrease from every allowed S0; sqrtN seed does not automatically satisfy hypotheses.
